```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(totalevalerror)
```

The `totalevalerror` package decomposes uncertainty in LLM-based evaluation into a crossed random-effects mixed model and projects standard errors under hypothetical evaluation designs. This vignette walks through the core workflow on simulated data; the per-benchmark vignettes (`mmlu`, `safety`, `arena-likert`, `heteroscedastic`) replicate the empirical analyses from Messing (2026).

## 1. Simulate a pilot

```{r simulate}
sim <- tee_simulate(
  N = 30, V = 4, M = 2, R = 3,
  variances = list(
    item = 0.20, prompt = 0.05,
    item_x_prompt = 0.04, item_x_judge = 0.10,
    cell_level = 0.02, replicate = 0.15
  ),
  scoring = "likert",
  seed = 1
)
head(sim)
```

## 2. Wrap the pilot in a `tee_design`

```{r design}
des <- tee_design(
  sim,
  outcome   = outcome,
  item      = item_id,
  prompt    = variant_id,
  judge     = judge_model,
  replicate = replication,
  scoring   = "likert"
)
des
```

## 3. Fit the variance decomposition

```{r decompose}
fit <- suppressMessages(tee_decompose(des))
fit
```

`tidy()`, `glance()`, and `augment()` give tidy views:

```{r tidy}
generics::tidy(fit) |> head()
generics::glance(fit)
```

## 4. Standard error and CI on theta-hat

```{r se}
tee_se(fit)
tee_theta_ci(fit, level = 0.95)
```

How much does the naive SE understate uncertainty?

```{r naive}
naive <- tee_naive_se(des)
tee_se_compare(fit, naive)
```

## 5. D-study: project under hypothetical designs

```{r dstudy}
proj <- tee_dstudy(fit)
proj$scenarios[, c("scenario", "se_total", "reduction_pct")]
```

## 6. Budget allocation

```{r budget}
alloc <- tee_budget_allocate(fit, budget = 600, n_pool = 200,
                             v_max = 5, r_max = 5)
alloc
```

Compare three strategies on the same budget:

```{r compare}
tee_budget_compare(fit, budget = 600, n_pool = 200)
```

## 7. Auto-paragraph for paper writeup

```{r writeup, results="asis"}
cat(tee_writeup(fit, style = "paper"))
```
